scenarios.recall_low_hp: own HP <= 2, Recall legal (cell <= -1), enemy present
scenarios.low_hp_lane: own HP <= 2 at or past the lane (Recall illegal), enemy present
scenarios.enemy_away: enemy champion away (recall or death), own champion present
scenarios.opp_trades: enemy present and the opponent policy's P(Trade) >= 0.6
scenarios.freeze_legal: Freeze legal (constructed: the opponent shoves SH-H for up to 4 turns from a mirror-game state)
scenarios.siege: siege objective legal (constructed: the focal shoves SH-H for up to 6 turns from a mirror-game state)
scenarios.skill_weak: both present, both HP >= 3, focal skill 0.2 vs enemy 0.8
scenarios.skill_strong: both present, both HP >= 3, focal skill 0.8 vs enemy 0.2
